annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I understand how shaken that trust must be
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My friend clearly feels betrayed right now
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: probably thinks I don't value the work we agreed to do together
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Because I understand how shaken that trust must be, I want to show up
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: My stomach's been in knots since I read that message

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They must believe I saw them as someone to take advantage of
annotations.ce_supportive_use: the only way to ease that fear in both of us is to actually show up
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: which terrifies me because that's not true
annotations.pda_repair_intention: hand over my half of whatever we earn until the trust rebuilds

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My friend probably expected me to have their back
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: the way they've always had mine, and that expectation got broken
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Knowing that, I think the right move is to insist we split
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: split the next payment evenly right away
annotations.pda_repair_intention: insist we split the next payment evenly right away

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I hate that possibility more than I can say
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They likely feel foolish now for trusting me
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: feel foolish now for trusting me
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Because I get why they'd feel that way, I think showing up
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: knot of dread in my chest just imagining facing them again

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My friend seems to think I only care about the money
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Understanding that fear pushes me to actually do the labor next time
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'm anxious about what happens if I mess this up twice

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they expected loyalty from me and got silence instead
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: that gap between hope and reality must sting
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Recognizing that gap, I want to make the next job entirely theirs to direct
annotations.pd_harm_distress: My chest tightens every time I imagine them painting alone again
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: let them set the terms, so some balance gets restored

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: that uncertainty must be exhausting for them
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My friend probably wonders now whether I'll vanish again
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Because I understand that worry, I think I owe them a clear plan
annotations.pda_repair_intention: a clear plan this time, showing dates and hours in advance

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I imagine they feel like a fool for believing in me
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: feel like a fool for believing in me
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: which is an awful thing to carry
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Since I get why that belief cracked, I think doing the next job properly

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They probably see me now as unreliable
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: someone who talks about partnership but disappears when it's inconvenient
annotations.ce_supportive_use: understanding how deep that impression runs, I think showing up fully

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I think my friend expects me to bail again
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: they're protecting themselves from being hurt twice
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Because I understand they're protecting themselves... I plan to show up early
annotations.pda_repair_intention: do the harder half of the work, and let actions carry the apology
